responsibility: This header declares the tempdir helper class used by libgccjit internals to manage on-disk intermediates. It exposes creation of the temporary directory, accessors for standard fake source/assembly/shared-object paths, and registration of additional temporary files to clean up, while inheriting logging support. It is the interface for scratch-directory lifecycle management during JIT and compile-to-file operations.
same_name_distinction: Declares the tempdir helper class interface, its path accessors, and tempfile-registration API that jit-tempdir.cc implements. Unlike the .cc file, it describes the scratch-directory object and layout without performing directory creation or cleanup.
